_readme: Known, intended differences between the base ref and HEAD. A difference matches an entry when its kind equals `kind` and `key` matches the regex `keyRegex` (and `old`/`new` equal the outcomes, `oldRegex`/`newRegex` match them, when given). Kinds: `may`, `docs`, `device` (differential), `mixed` (stable app on new documents; key = the case), `surface` (key = a changed student-data file), `e2e` (T4 journeys). Anything that matches nothing is a finding and fails the run. Empty this list after each release goes to production: the base then already contains the changes.

intended.reason: Owner ruling (Decision 11): admins act on campus data only on their own address's campus (merge professors, contribute).
Owner ruling: admins get the Phase A course tools (structures, bulk upload, degree requirements, averages, professors, moderation) on their own campus.

Matrix artifact, not a behaviour change: a row whose reach is the campus (read roster, contribute) was answered per department by the old table; the new one ignores the scope argument. Callers pass no scope for these rows; the null-scope cells are unchanged (they are not in the diff).
Owner ruling: owners and admins may pick the campus Reviews/Resources/Representatives show (Settings › Campus); an owner's saved previewCampus now wins over their address's campus.
Custom roles are new: the new code reads a `custom` grant / directory role the base build cannot.
Decision 11 / bfe3cd4 (BRK-001/002/009): a president's or CR's campus is their address's own; a goa address's CR grant on a hyderabad course is honoured by neither the rules nor (now) the app.

Hardening (backtest fixes, 2026-11-23): a grant/directory doc with a missing, wrong-typed or unknown field no longer throws in loadMine/roster; the stable app threw. The reverse (new throws) still fails the run as a break.

178856a: a cached roles entry with one damaged grant keeps the cached identity and drops only that grant (the stable app dropped the whole cache); both then show no staff tools until the live roles load.

Known open item (Builder, 2026-11-23): the stable app throws on custom grants and drops staff.reach when it appoints a custom-role holder; the rules read a missing reach as empty (42e4851). Fixed only by an owner-side stable release; delete this entry once that ships.

Reviewed for the test-architecture build: lib/sync.dart's output is checked by this same run (old and new must push byte-identical users/{uid} documents; a difference is a separate 'sync-differs' break), and the grading, timings and main.dart changes compute or start the app without encoding synced boxes. Re-review (delete this entry) before the next release.
